preconditions.description: The number of nodes in each tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The number of edges in each tree is between 1 and 10^5.
The array A contains exactly 2*e space-separated values representing edges.
The array B contains exactly 2*e space-separated values representing edges.

postconditions.description: The function returns 1 if the trees are mirror images of each other, otherwise returns 0.
